purpose: DEVELOPMENT ONLY: declared-contract correctness and selection effectiveness are distinct

metricDefinitions.unit: one explicit truth-labelled content unit per distinct block ID; repeated wrappers count once
metricDefinitions.usefulPreservation: included useful units / all useful units
metricDefinitions.irrelevantRejection: non-included irrelevant units / all irrelevant units (filtering or budget exclusion)
metricDefinitions.admissionPrecision: admitted useful units / all admitted units, before budget allocation
metricDefinitions.admissionRecall: admitted useful units / all useful units, before budget allocation
metricDefinitions.aggregation: micro sums numerators and denominators; macro averages defined per-case ratios; empty denominators are null
metricDefinitions.failures: failed compilations have no selection result and are excluded from effectiveness, counted separately
metricDefinitions.gates: only authored contract checks control this command exit status; no effectiveness or product validation gate
